theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible leader and the rotation leader, consistent with the detector's focus lens pointing where current leadership is concentrated. Its durability_bar of 0.48 sits just above headline level but its Hurst tag is mean-revert and breadth is only 0.30, so this is a fragile single-narrative lead, not a durable trend. I lean with the prevailing narrative direction but keep conviction low because the trend gate has no validated edge here and the rank-IC is ~0.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.137, eligible=true (the only strong eligible name)
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting Hurst tag plus weak breadth means the coal move could snap back quickly; with only 9% of the universe eligible, leadership is concentrated in one name with no confirmed follow-through.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the challenger with a strong durability_bar (0.80), healthy breadth (0.778), and a trend Hurst tag — the most structurally sound theme in the ranking. It is crowded (z=1.77), which is a size-down caution only, not a fade signal. The very narrow margin (0.027) to Coal suggests a confirmed handoff candidate, but rotation timing has no validated edge, so I treat this as watching a durable trend rather than a forecast.
evidence: rotation challenger with margin=0.027 to leader (close handoff)
